mechanics: 100-Ki Other-type Super available from the Skill Shop after the documented Majin Buu progression. The user creates a ranged dark-red grab sphere that holds the opponent in place for several seconds, then deals additional damage and releases them. When used after a knockback, the grab can appear along the opponent's flight path. Exact hold duration, damage, and frame data remain unresolved.
